mapper.select: SELECT id,capacity_snapshot,qualified_staff_count_snapshot FROM schedule_reservation WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT new_snapshot FROM schedule_reservation_change WHERE id=#{change} AND order_id=#{order} AND reservation_id=#{reservation} AND store_id=#{store} AND new_version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_reservation_claim SET window_id=#{window},start_at=#{start},end_at=#{end} WHERE id=#{id} AND reservation_id=#{reservation} AND kind=#{kind}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_reservation_change(id,reservation_id,order_id,store_id,command_id,old_version,new_version,old_snapshot,new_snapshot,changed_at) VALUES(#{id},#{reservation},#{orderId},#{storeId},#{command},#{version},#{version}+1,CAST(#{old} AS JSON),CAST(#{new} AS JSON),#{now})
